# Lexical Item

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:LexicalItem`](gmeow-LexicalItem.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/LexicalItem>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/lexicon`](../../slices/lexicon.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The abstract lexical or constructional object: a word, morpheme, phrase, idiom, symbol, sign, or construction. Carries no surface form itself; forms are linked via [`gmeow:hasLexicalForm`](../properties/gmeow-hasLexicalForm.md). Aligns to OntoLex LexicalEntry by reference, but is broader than names (which are modeled in the names module as [`Appellation`](gmeow-Appellation.md)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:LexicalItem`](gmeow-LexicalItem.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

### Word Etymology

- **Source:** [`slices/extensions/lexicon/examples/word-etymology.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/extensions/lexicon/examples/word-etymology.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-extensions-lexicon-examples-word-etymology)#example-slices-extensions-lexicon-examples-word-etymology

```turtle
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Blackcat Informatics® Inc. <paudley@blackcatinformatics.ca>
# SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0
#
# Worked example: a word, its forms, and its etymology . A gmeow:LexicalItem
# is a lexeme in a language; its written/spoken/signed surface strings are
# separate gmeow:LexicalForms (gmeow:hasLexicalForm), so the same lexeme can carry
# many forms across scripts and registers. A gmeow:EtymologicalDerivation reifies
# WHERE a word came from — source → target with a gmeow:derivationKind
# (inheritance / borrowing / calque / sound-change …) — so "English 'ontology'
# was BORROWED from Greek" is a first-class, typed claim, not a free-text note.
@prefix gmeow: <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/> .
@prefix ex:    <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/examples/lexicon/> .
@prefix rdfs:  <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .

# --- The English lexeme and its written form.
ex:ontology a gmeow:LexicalItem ;
    gmeow:lexicalItemLanguage gmeow:langEnglish ;
    gmeow:hasLexicalForm      ex:ontologyForm .
```

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the abstract word, morpheme, phrase, idiom, symbol, sign, or construction itself — the lexical entry that carries no surface string but is realized by one or more forms.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for a concrete surface form (that is [`gmeow:LexicalForm`](gmeow-LexicalForm.md)) and for a proper-name appellation (use the names slice's [`Appellation`](gmeow-Appellation.md), which is the specialized onomastic construct).

### How to use

- Mint the item, fix its language with [`gmeow:lexicalItemLanguage`](../properties/gmeow-lexicalItemLanguage.md), and attach concrete forms with [`gmeow:hasLexicalForm`](../properties/gmeow-hasLexicalForm.md); model translation equivalents as separate items linked rather than as one polyglot item.

### Examples

- ex:wordWater a [`gmeow:LexicalItem`](gmeow-LexicalItem.md); [`gmeow:lexicalItemLanguage`](../properties/gmeow-lexicalItemLanguage.md) ex:english; [`gmeow:hasLexicalForm`](../properties/gmeow-hasLexicalForm.md) ex:waterWritten.
